decisions.mark: explains that `skipSync: true` stops the single incoming reaction being treated as the post's complete set — without it every other reaction on the post would be deleted
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "Without it, the diff would treat every existing reaction on the post that is not in the one-item payload as stale and delete it. A single `reaction_added` event would wipe the other reactions on that post." | WHY: The answer explains that `skipSync: true` prevents the single incoming reaction from being treated as the full set, which would otherwise delete all other reactions on the post. || QUOTE: "Without it, the diff would treat every existing reaction on the post that is not in the one-item payload as stale and delete it.
